add.event: 英国暂停金本位，是储备流向美国的原因之一
add.evidence: the suspension of the gold standard in Britain on September 21, 1931

add.event: 第6102号行政令规定美国公民持有或交易黄金为刑事犯罪
add.evidence: A year earlier, in 1933, Executive Order 6102 had made it a criminal offense for U.S. citizens to own or trade gold

add.event: 对私人持有黄金的限制被废除，1974年12月31日生效
add.evidence: The Gold Reserve Act limitations on private gold ownership were repealed in a rider to the International Development Association Appropriations Act of 1975, signed by President Gerald Ford on August 14, 1974, and effective December 31, 1974.
